h: SEC approves share allocation for oversubscribed Dangote Refinery IPO
p: The Securities and Exchange Commission has approved the share allocation plan for Dangote Refinery's initial public offering. Demand reportedly reached about three times the shares on offer.
body: Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved the share allocation plan for Dangote Petroleum Refinery's initial public offering (IPO), moving the company closer to listing on the stock market.
The approval was granted on Monday, 23 November 2026, and marks a key milestone for the refinery and the investors who took part in the offer, which closed in October.
Demand for the shares reportedly reached about three times the original offer size, reflecting strong interest in owning a stake in one of Africa's largest industrial projects.
With the allocation plan approved, the refinery moves closer to its stock market debut.
more: The SEC gave approval on 23 November.
The IPO was about three times oversubscribed.
The refinery is moving towards its stock market debut.
